description: This file contains implementation of classes and functions related to process container management within the WPEFramework, including network interface iteration, container administration, and container control functions.

classes.name: CNetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for network interfaces of a container, providing access to interface name, IP addresses, and count.

classes.name: CContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class managing container instances, providing creation, removal, and logging functionalities.

classes.name: CContainer
classes.description: Represents a container, providing methods to retrieve status, control execution, and manage references.

methods.name: CNetworkInterfaceIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network interface.

methods.name: CNetworkInterfaceIterator::NumAddresses
methods.description: Returns the number of IP addresses associated with the current network interface.

methods.name: CNetworkInterfaceIterator::IP
methods.description: Returns the IP address at the specified index for the current network interface.

methods.name: CContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates and returns a new container instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: CContainer::Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information of the container.

methods.name: CContainer::Cpu
methods.description: Retrieves CPU usage information of the container.

methods.name: CContainer::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the network interfaces of the container.

methods.name: CContainer::IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: CContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts a process inside the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: CContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container process, with an optional timeout.

methods.name: CContainer::AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the container object.

methods.name: CContainer::Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object if count reaches zero.
